assertions.assertion: Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is coded with CPT 93229
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope associated with palpitations, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
There is a need for continuous rhythm correlation during daily activities
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is ordered to capture potential arrhythmic events
The procedure directly addresses the intermittent symptoms and supports the diagnostic evaluation required for the identified clinical concern
